additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432517-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S1 313508370046] Logs request CRM:02832000116
additional_info.body:
Buonasera Filomena,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services Team in regards of ticket
ID0432517
. The ticket was opened for #2 charging attempts failed today on charger
amWo91
in Ciampino.
I had a look at the logs and the charger configuration, and I found the issue: for both charging sessions, it was authorized the charging on one outlet, but it was connected the other one.
I believe the origin of the issue is in the OCPP configuration of the charger. I see that the outlet DC1 (which usually it is referred to as "outlet 1") is configured to be "outlet 2", and viceversa for outlet DC2.
Therefore, you can see in the logs that the authorization via app is for "OCPP outlet 2" (which is DC1 as per configuration), but the charging attempt is on DC2 (which is "outlet 1" as per configuration):
Same goes for the charging attempt at 11:24:
You can see here an example of a successful charging session, just few minutes ago. Authorization via app of "outlet 1" and plug in of DC2:
I believe that for an end-user who is familiar  the Sicharge D platform, this configuration of outlets might be confusing.
I copy Luca in cc for his knowledge, to discuss with IPlanet the topic of this OCPP configuration.
I will proceed to close this ticket.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you and have a nice weekend!
With kind regards,
